32	        self.role_worker_mapping = {}
33	        self.mapping = {}
34	
35	    def add_actor_rollout_worker(self, config):
36	        """Add actor rollout worker using the unified model engine implementation."""
37	        from verl.single_controller.ray import RayWorkerGroup
38	        from verl.trainer.ppo.ray_trainer import Role
39	        from verl.workers.engine_workers import ActorRolloutRefWorker
40	
41	        actor_rollout_cls = ActorRolloutRefWorker
42	        ray_worker_group_cls = RayWorkerGroup
43	
44	        lora_rank = config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora", {}).get("rank", 0)
45	        if lora_rank <= 0:
46	            lora_rank = config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora_rank", 0)
47	        ref_in_actor = lora_rank > 0 or config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora_adapter_path") is not None
48	        # Ref policy is fused into ActorRolloutRefWorker unless LoRA is used with a dedicated ref model.
49	        if need_reference_policy(config) and not ref_in_actor:
50	            role = Role.ActorRolloutRef
51	        else:
52	            role = Role.ActorRollout
53	        self.role_worker_mapping[role] = ray.remote(actor_rollout_cls)
54	        self.mapping[role] = "global_pool"
55	        return actor_rollout_cls, ray_worker_group_cls
56	
57	    def add_critic_worker(self, config):
58	        """Add critic worker to role mapping using the unified model engine implementation."""
59	        from verl.trainer.ppo.ray_trainer import Role
60	        from verl.workers.engine_workers import TrainingWorker
61	
62	        # The model-engine TrainingWorker handles all critic backends (fsdp/fsdp2/megatron/...)
63	        # internally based on ``config.critic.strategy``.
64	        self.role_worker_mapping[Role.Critic] = ray.remote(TrainingWorker)
65	        self.mapping[Role.Critic] = "global_pool"
66	
67	    def init_resource_pool_mgr(self, config):
68	        """Initialize resource pool manager."""
69	
70	        global_pool_id = "global_pool"
71	        resource_pool_spec = {
72	            global_pool_id: [config.trainer.n_gpus_per_node] * config.trainer.nnodes,
73	        }
74	
75	        if config.reward.reward_model.enable_resource_pool:
76	            if config.reward.reward_model.n_gpus_per_node <= 0:
77	                raise ValueError("config.reward.reward_model.n_gpus_per_node must be greater than 0")
78	            if config.reward.reward_model.nnodes <= 0:
79	                raise ValueError("config.reward.reward_model.nnodes must be greater than 0")
80	
81	            reward_pool = [config.reward.reward_model.n_gpus_per_node] * config.reward.reward_model.nnodes
82	            resource_pool_spec["reward_pool"] = reward_pool
83	        else:
84	            config.reward.reward_model.nnodes = config.trainer.nnodes
85	            config.reward.reward_model.n_gpus_per_node = config.trainer.n_gpus_per_node
86	
87	        distillation_config = config.get("distillation")
88	        if is_distillation_enabled(distillation_config):
89	            if distillation_config.n_gpus_per_node <= 0:
90	                raise ValueError("config.distillation.n_gpus_per_node must be greater than 0")
91	            if distillation_config.nnodes <= 0:
92	                raise ValueError("config.distillation.nnodes must be greater than 0")
93	
94	            teacher_pool = [distillation_config.n_gpus_per_node] * distillation_config.nnodes
95	            resource_pool_spec["teacher_pool"] = teacher_pool
96	
97	        from verl.trainer.ppo.ray_trainer import ResourcePoolManager
98	
99	        resource_pool_manager = ResourcePoolManager(resource_pool_spec=resource_pool_spec, mapping=self.mapping)
100	        return resource_pool_manager
101	
102	    def add_reward_model_resource_pool(self, config):
103	        """Add reward model worker if enabled."""
104	        from verl.trainer.ppo.ray_trainer import Role
105	
106	        if config.reward.reward_model.enable:
107	            # we do not use reward model workers, so we only register reward model in resource pool
108	            # without continue to register reward model worker in role mapping
109	            if config.reward.reward_model.enable_resource_pool:
110	                self.mapping[Role.RewardModel] = "reward_pool"
111	            else:
112	                self.mapping[Role.RewardModel] = "global_pool"
113	
114	    def add_teacher_model_resource_pool(self, config):
115	        """Add teacher model worker if enabled."""
116	        from verl.trainer.ppo.ray_trainer import Role
117	
118	        if is_distillation_enabled(config.get("distillation")):
119	            # we do not use teacher model workers, so we only register teacher model in resource pool
120	            # without registering a teacher model worker in role-worker mapping
121	            self.mapping[Role.TeacherModel] = "teacher_pool"
122	
123	    def add_ref_policy_worker(self, config, ref_policy_cls):
124	        """Ref policy is fused into ActorRolloutRefWorker in the unified model engine.
125	
126	        Kept for backward compatibility with subclasses that still invoke it; the method
127	        is now a no-op because the reference policy lives on the same worker group as
128	        the actor/rollout.
129	        """
130	        return
131	
132	    def run(self, config):
133	        pass
134	
135	
136	@ray.remote
137	class TaskRunner(BaseTaskRunner):
138	    """Ray remote class for executing distributed PPO training tasks.
139	
140	    This class encapsulates the main training logic and runs as a Ray remote actor
141	    to enable distributed execution across multiple nodes and GPUs.
142	
143	    Attributes:
144	        role_worker_mapping: Dictionary mapping Role enums to Ray remote worker classes
145	        mapping: Dictionary mapping Role enums to resource pool IDs for GPU allocation
146	    """
147	
148	    def __init__(self):
149	        super().__init__()
150	
151	    def run(self, config):
152	        """Execute the main PPO training workflow.
153	
154	        This method sets up the distributed training environment, initializes
155	        workers, datasets, and reward functions, then starts the training process.
156	
157	        Args:
158	            config: Training configuration object containing all parameters needed
159	                   for setting up and running the PPO training process.
160	        """
161	        # Print the initial configuration. `resolve=True` will evaluate symbolic values.
162	        from pprint import pprint
163	
164	        from verl.utils.fs import copy_to_local
165	
166	        print(f"TaskRunner hostname: {socket.gethostname()}, PID: {os.getpid()}")
167	        pprint(OmegaConf.to_container(config, resolve=True))
168	        OmegaConf.resolve(config)
169	
170	        actor_rollout_cls, ray_worker_group_cls = self.add_actor_rollout_worker(config)
171	        self.add_critic_worker(config)
172	
173	        self.add_reward_model_resource_pool(config)
174	
175	        self.add_teacher_model_resource_pool(config)
176	
177	        # Add a reference policy worker if KL loss or KL reward is used.
178	        self.add_ref_policy_worker(config, actor_rollout_cls)
179	
180	        # validate config
181	        validate_config(
182	            config=config,
183	            use_reference_policy=need_reference_policy(config),
184	            use_critic=need_critic(config),
185	        )
186	
187	        # Download the checkpoint from HDFS to the local machine.
188	        # `use_shm` determines whether to use shared memory, which could lead to faster model loading if turned on
189	        local_path = copy_to_local(
190	            config.actor_rollout_ref.model.path, use_shm=config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("use_shm", False)
191	        )
192	
193	        # Instantiate the tokenizer and processor.
194	        from verl.utils import hf_processor, hf_tokenizer
195	
196	        trust_remote_code = config.data.get("trust_remote_code", False)
197	        tokenizer = hf_tokenizer(local_path, trust_remote_code=trust_remote_code)
198	        # Used for multimodal LLM, could be None
199	        processor = hf_processor(local_path, trust_remote_code=trust_remote_code, use_fast=True)
200	
201	        resource_pool_manager = self.init_resource_pool_mgr(config)
202	
203	        from verl.utils.dataset.rl_dataset import collate_fn
204	
205	        # Create training and validation datasets.
206	        train_dataset = create_rl_dataset(
207	            config.data.train_files,
208	            config.data,
209	            tokenizer,
210	            processor,
211	            is_train=True,
212	            max_samples=config.data.get("train_max_samples", -1),
213	        )
214	        val_dataset = create_rl_dataset(
215	            config.data.val_files,
216	            config.data,
217	            tokenizer,
218	            processor,
219	            is_train=False,
220	            max_samples=config.data.get("val_max_samples", -1),
221	        )
222	        train_sampler = create_rl_sampler(config.data, train_dataset)
223	
224	        # Initialize the PPO trainer.
225	        trainer = RayPPOTrainer(
226	            config=config,
227	            tokenizer=tokenizer,
228	            processor=processor,
229	            role_worker_mapping=self.role_worker_mapping,
230	            resource_pool_manager=resource_pool_manager,
231	            ray_worker_group_cls=ray_worker_group_cls,
232	            train_dataset=train_dataset,
233	            val_dataset=val_dataset,
234	            collate_fn=collate_fn,
235	            train_sampler=train_sampler,
236	        )
237	        # Initialize the workers of the trainer.
238	        trainer.init_workers()
239	
240	        # Start the training process.
241	        trainer.fit()

23	
24	
25	def init_megatron_optim_config(
26	    optim_config: dict,
27	    use_distributed_optimizer: bool = True,
28	    fp16: bool = False,
29	    bf16: bool = True,
30	) -> OptimizerConfig:
31	    optim_args = {
32	        "optimizer": optim_config.optimizer,
33	        "lr": optim_config.lr,
34	        "min_lr": optim_config.min_lr,
35	        "clip_grad": optim_config.clip_grad,
36	        "weight_decay": optim_config.weight_decay,
37	        "use_distributed_optimizer": use_distributed_optimizer,
38	    }
39	    if fp16:
40	        optim_args.update(
41	            {
42	                "bf16": False,
43	                "fp16": True,
44	                "params_dtype": torch.float16,
45	                "initial_loss_scale": 32768,
46	                "min_loss_scale": 1,
47	                "use_precision_aware_optimizer": True,
48	                "store_param_remainders": False,
49	            }
50	        )
51	    elif bf16:
52	        optim_args.update(
53	            {
54	                "bf16": True,
55	                "params_dtype": torch.bfloat16,
56	            }
57	        )
58	        # Precision-aware optimizer is opt-in (default keeps the grad-accumulation
59	        # buffer and Adam moments (m, v) at Megatron's fp32 default, preserving
60	        # prior numerics). When enabled via config, those buffers follow the
61	        # configured dtypes so optimizer-state memory can track the model dtype.
62	        # Master parameters stay fp32 (Megatron default `main_params_dtype`)
63	        # because TE FusedAdam currently rejects bf16 master weights at init
64	        # (only fp32/fp16 accepted); the int16 `store_param_remainders` path
65	        # already trims the fp32 master buffer in bf16 mode. Requires
66	        # TransformerEngine's FusedAdam. The DDP grad-bucket dtype is kept
67	        # consistent with `main_grads_dtype` by the engine at model-build time.
68	        if optim_config.get("use_precision_aware_optimizer", False):
69	            optim_args.update(
70	                {
71	                    "use_precision_aware_optimizer": True,
72	                    "main_grads_dtype": PrecisionType.to_dtype(optim_config.get("main_grads_dtype", "fp32")),
73	                    "exp_avg_dtype": PrecisionType.to_dtype(optim_config.get("exp_avg_dtype", "fp32")),
74	                    "exp_avg_sq_dtype": PrecisionType.to_dtype(optim_config.get("exp_avg_sq_dtype", "fp32")),
75	                }
76	            )
77	    else:
78	        # fp32 mode: leave grad-accumulation buffer and Adam moments at
79	        # Megatron's default torch.float32. Do not enable the precision-aware
80	        # optimizer — it's only beneficial when a moment/grad dtype is below
81	        # fp32, and Megatron asserts the dtype fields equal fp32 whenever the
82	        # precision-aware optimizer is off (optimizer_config.py:258-268).
83	        optim_args.update(
84	            {
85	                "bf16": False,
86	                "fp16": False,
87	                "params_dtype": torch.float32,
88	            }
89	        )
90	    override_config = optim_config.get("override_optimizer_config", {})
91	    if override_config:
92	        for k, v in override_config.items():
93	            optim_args[k] = v
94	
95	    print_rank_0(f"optimizer config after override: {optim_args}")
96	
97	    config = OptimizerConfig(**optim_args)
98	    return config
99

101	def get_megatron_optimizer(
102	    model,
103	    config: OptimizerConfig,
104	):
105	    # Base optimizer.
106	    return get_megatron_optimizer_native(
107	        config=config,
108	        model_chunks=model,
109	    )
110	
111	
112	def get_megatron_optimizer_param_scheduler(
113	    optimizer,
114	    config,
115	):
116	    """
117	    Get the optimizer parameter scheduler for Megatron.
118	    """
119	    lr_decay_steps = config.lr_decay_steps
120	    lr_warmup_steps = config.lr_warmup_steps
121	    if config.get("lr_decay_steps", None) is None:
122	        lr_decay_steps = config.total_training_steps
123	    wsd_decay_steps = None
124	    if config.get("lr_wsd_decay_steps", None) is not None:
125	        wsd_decay_steps = config.lr_wsd_decay_steps
126	    if config.get("lr_warmup_steps_ratio", None) is not None and (
127	        config.get("lr_warmup_steps", None) is None or config.lr_warmup_steps <= 0
128	    ):
129	        lr_warmup_steps = int(config.lr_warmup_steps_ratio * lr_decay_steps)
130	
131	    opt_param_scheduler = OptimizerParamScheduler(
132	        optimizer,
133	        init_lr=config.lr_warmup_init,
134	        max_lr=config.lr,
135	        min_lr=config.min_lr,
136	        lr_warmup_steps=lr_warmup_steps,
137	        lr_decay_steps=lr_decay_steps,
138	        lr_decay_style=config.lr_decay_style,
139	        start_wd=config.weight_decay,
140	        end_wd=config.weight_decay,
141	        wd_incr_steps=config.total_training_steps,
142	        wd_incr_style=config.weight_decay_incr_style,
143	        use_checkpoint_opt_param_scheduler=config.use_checkpoint_opt_param_scheduler,
144	        override_opt_param_scheduler=(not config.use_checkpoint_opt_param_scheduler),
145	        wsd_decay_steps=wsd_decay_steps,
146	        lr_wsd_decay_style=config.lr_wsd_decay_style,
147	    )
148	
149	    return opt_param_scheduler
150	
151	
152	def get_megatron_last_lr(optimizer):
153	    """
154	    Get the last learning rate from the optimizer parameter scheduler.
155	    """
156	    return optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]

import torch
from megatron.core.optimizer import OptimizerConfig
from megatron.core.optimizer import get_megatron_optimizer as get_megatron_optimizer_native
from megatron.core.optimizer_param_scheduler import OptimizerParamScheduler

from verl.utils.logger import print_rank_0
from verl.utils.torch_dtypes import PrecisionType


def init_megatron_optim_config(
    optim_config: dict,
    use_distributed_optimizer: bool = True,
    fp16: bool = False,
    bf16: bool = True,
) -> OptimizerConfig:
    optim_args = {
        "optimizer": optim_config.optimizer,
        "lr": optim_config.lr,
        "min_lr": optim_config.min_lr,
        "clip_grad": optim_config.clip_grad,
        "weight_decay": optim_config.weight_decay,
        "use_distributed_optimizer": use_distributed_optimizer,
    }
    if fp16:
        optim_args.update(
            {
                "bf16": False,
                "fp16": True,
                "params_dtype": torch.float16,
                "initial_loss_scale": 32768,
                "min_loss_scale": 1,
                "use_precision_aware_optimizer": True,
                "store_param_remainders": False,
            }
        )
    elif bf16:
        optim_args.update(
            {
                "bf16": True,
                "params_dtype": torch.bfloat16,
            }
        )
        # Precision-aware optimizer is opt-in (default keeps the grad-accumulation
        # buffer and Adam moments (m, v) at Megatron's fp32 default, preserving
        # prior numerics). When enabled via config, those buffers follow the
        # configured dtypes so optimizer-state memory can track the model dtype.
        # Master parameters stay fp32 (Megatron default `main_params_dtype`)
        # because TE FusedAdam currently rejects bf16 master weights at init
        # (only fp32/fp16 accepted); the int16 `store_param_remainders` path
        # already trims the fp32 master buffer in bf16 mode. Requires
        # TransformerEngine's FusedAdam. The DDP grad-bucket dtype is kept
        # consistent with `main_grads_dtype` by the engine at model-build time.

            optim_args.update(
                {
                    "use_precision_aware_optimizer": True,
                    "main_grads_dtype": PrecisionType.to_dtype(optim_config.get("main_grads_dtype", "fp32")),
                    "exp_avg_dtype": PrecisionType.to_dtype(optim_config.get("exp_avg_dtype", "fp32")),
                    "exp_avg_sq_dtype": PrecisionType.to_dtype(optim_config.get("exp_avg_sq_dtype", "fp32")),
                }
            )
    else:
        # fp32 mode: leave grad-accumulation buffer and Adam moments at
        # Megatron's default torch.float32. Do not enable the precision-aware
        # optimizer — it's only beneficial when a moment/grad dtype is below
        # fp32, and Megatron asserts the dtype fields equal fp32 whenever the
        # precision-aware optimizer is off (optimizer_config.py:258-268).

            {

                "fp16": False,
                "params_dtype": torch.float32,

    if override_config:
        for k, v in override_config.items():

    config = OptimizerConfig(**optim_args)

def get_megatron_optimizer(
    model,
    config: OptimizerConfig,
):
    # Base optimizer.
    return get_megatron_optimizer_native(
        config=config,
        model_chunks=model,

def get_megatron_optimizer_param_scheduler(
    optimizer,
    config,
):
    """
    Get the optimizer parameter scheduler for Megatron.
    """
    lr_decay_steps = config.lr_decay_steps
    lr_warmup_steps = config.lr_warmup_steps
    if config.get("lr_decay_steps", None) is None:
        lr_decay_steps = config.total_training_steps
    wsd_decay_steps = None
    if config.get("lr_wsd_decay_steps", None) is not None:

    if config.get("lr_warmup_steps_ratio", None) is not None and (
        config.get("lr_warmup_steps", None) is None or config.lr_warmup_steps <= 0
    ):
        lr_warmup_steps = int(config.lr_warmup_steps_ratio * lr_decay_steps)

    opt_param_scheduler = OptimizerParamScheduler(
        optimizer,
        init_lr=config.lr_warmup_init,
        max_lr=config.lr,
        min_lr=config.min_lr,
        lr_warmup_steps=lr_warmup_steps,
        lr_decay_steps=lr_decay_steps,
        lr_decay_style=config.lr_decay_style,
        start_wd=config.weight_decay,
        end_wd=config.weight_decay,
        wd_incr_steps=config.total_training_steps,
        wd_incr_style=config.weight_decay_incr_style,
        use_checkpoint_opt_param_scheduler=config.use_checkpoint_opt_param_scheduler,
        override_opt_param_scheduler=(not config.use_checkpoint_opt_param_scheduler),
        wsd_decay_steps=wsd_decay_steps,
        lr_wsd_decay_style=config.lr_wsd_decay_style,
    )

    return opt_param_scheduler


def get_megatron_last_lr(optimizer):
    """
    Get the last learning rate from the optimizer parameter scheduler.
    """
    return optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]

# Copyright (c) 2024, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
import copy
import logging
import warnings
from dataclasses import astuple
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

import torch
from torch.optim import SGD as CPUSGD
from torch.optim import AdamW as CPUAdam

try:
    from transformer_engine.pytorch.optimizers import FusedAdam as Adam
    from transformer_engine.pytorch.optimizers import FusedSGD as SGD

    USING_PYTORCH_OPTIMIZER = False
except ImportError:
    try:
        from apex.optimizers import FusedAdam as Adam
        from apex.optimizers import FusedSGD as SGD

        USING_PYTORCH_OPTIMIZER = False
    except ImportError:
        warnings.warn(
            f'Transformer Engine and Apex are not installed. Falling back to Torch optimizers.'
        )

        # Apex's FusedAdam is a drop-in replacement for torch's AdamW.
        # pylint: disable-next=line-too-long.
        # See https://github.com/NVIDIA/apex/blob/7b73b12361068a10b0f44844534613f252a5ea75/apex/optimizers/fused_adam.py#L16.
        from torch.optim import SGD
        from torch.optim import AdamW as Adam

        USING_PYTORCH_OPTIMIZER = True

from megatron.core import parallel_state
from megatron.core.optimizer.cpu_offloading.hybrid_optimizer import HybridDeviceOptimizer
from megatron.core.optimizer_param_scheduler import (
    ParamGroupOverride,
    combine_param_group_overrides,
    param_group_override_to_tuple,
)
from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
from megatron.core.transformer.fsdp_dtensor_checkpoint import get_global_unique_param_name

from ..distributed.param_and_grad_buffer import _ParamAndGradBuffer
from ..transformer.module import MegatronModule
from ..utils import get_model_config, get_pg_rank, get_pg_size, is_te_min_version, log_single_rank
from .distrib_optimizer import DistributedOptimizer
from .grad_scaler import ConstantGradScaler, DynamicGradScaler
from .optimizer import (
    ChainedOptimizer,
    Float16OptimizerWithFloat16Params,
    FP32Optimizer,
    MegatronOptimizer,
    param_group_identifier_keys,
)
from .optimizer_config import (
    AdamOptimizerConfig,
    OptimizerConfig,
    ParamKey,
    ParamPredicate,
    ParamWithNamePredicate,
    SGDOptimizerConfig,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def get_standard_config_overrides(config: OptimizerConfig) -> Dict[ParamKey, ParamGroupOverride]:
    """Get standard config overrides for the optimizer, handling decoupled LR and common wd skips.

    Args:
        config (OptimizerConfig): optimizer configuration object.

    Returns:
        Dict[ParamKey, ParamGroupOverride]: standard config overrides.
    """
    config_overrides: Optional[Dict[ParamKey, ParamGroupOverride]] = {}
    # First, figure out how we are going to do wd skipping. The two main approaches are:
    #  1. The classic megatron approach of skipping all len 1 and bias parameters.
    #  2. The Qwen3-Next approach of doing 1, other than qk layernorm parameters.
    if config.apply_wd_to_qk_layernorm:
        shape_1_not_qkln_param = ParamWithNamePredicate(
            name="s1_not_qkln",
            fn=lambda param, name: (len(param.shape) == 1 or name.endswith(".bias"))
            and not ("q_layernorm." in name or "k_layernorm." in name),
        )
        param_wd_mult_key = ParamKey(with_name_predicate=shape_1_not_qkln_param)
    else:
        param_length_1_match = ParamPredicate(
            name="param_len_1", fn=lambda param: len(param.shape) == 1
        )
        param_wd_mult_key = ParamKey(name="*.bias", predicate=param_length_1_match)

    config_overrides[param_wd_mult_key] = ParamGroupOverride(wd_mult=0.0)

    if config.decoupled_lr is not None:
        decoupled_lr_config: ParamGroupOverride = {"max_lr": config.decoupled_lr}
        decoupled_param_key = ParamKey(attr="is_embedding_or_output_parameter")
        if config.decoupled_min_lr is not None:
            decoupled_lr_config["min_lr"] = config.decoupled_min_lr
        config_overrides[decoupled_param_key] = decoupled_lr_config

    return config_overrides


def _get_param_groups(
    model_chunks: List[MegatronModule],
    config: OptimizerConfig,
    config_overrides: Optional[Dict[ParamKey, ParamGroupOverride]],
) -> List[Dict]:
    """Create parameter groups for optimizer.

    Creates parameter groups from provided optimizer config object.

    NOTE There can be more than one match between a ParamKey and a parameter.
        What we do is merge all of the matching ParamKey overrides into a single ParamGroupOverride
        for that parameter and use that as the key for that parameter. Any parameters that get
        the same set of merged overrides will be mapped into the same parameter group.

    Args:
        model_chunks (List[MegatronModule]): model chunks to create parameter
            groups for.
        config (OptimizerConfig): optimizer configuration object.
        config_overrides (Optional[Dict[ParamKey, ParamGroupOverride]): optimizer overrides,
            specified on a per-layer basis. NOTE: if you want to skip applying weight decay on bias
            and length 1 parameters, and also do not want to do any other overrides, set this to an
            empty dictionary rather than the default value of None.
    Returns:
        List of parameter groups.
    """

    # Map (pg_overrides, is_expert_parallel) to params.
    params_map = {}

    if config_overrides is None:
        # TODO remove this default behavior eventually.
        #  This is only needed for backwards compatibility with the old config overrides API where
        #  the config_overrides argument by default lead to bias parameters and length 1 parameters.
        #  We assume that users of decoupled LR already provide config overrides so will adapt
        #  to the new API.
        config_overrides = get_standard_config_overrides(config=config)

    for model_chunk in model_chunks:
        for name, param in model_chunk.named_parameters():
            if not param.requires_grad:
                continue

            uses_default_config = False
            # Get optimizer config overrides for this parameter.
            param_overrides_list: list[ParamGroupOverride] = []
            if config_overrides is not None:
                for param_key, param_override in config_overrides.items():
                    if param_key.matches(param, name):
                        param_overrides_list.append(param_override)

            if param_overrides_list:
                param_override: ParamGroupOverride | None = combine_param_group_overrides(
                    param_overrides_list
                )
            else:

    # TODO: Remove `optimizer` from this eventually (e.g., if we use Muon for some layers and

        fields_to_check_for_consistency = [
            'overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step',
            'optimizer',
            'optimizer_cpu_offload',

        for field_name in fields_to_check_for_consistency:
            base_field = getattr(config, field_name, None)
            all_config_overrides = list(config_overrides.values())
            for config_override in all_config_overrides:

14	class HybridDeviceOptimizer(torch.optim.Optimizer):
15	    """
16	    HybridDeviceOptimizer is a custom optimizer designed to facilitate
17	    hybrid parameter updates across GPU and CPU. This optimizer allows
18	    users to adjust the fraction of parameters updated on the CPU and
19	    GPU through the `offload_fraction` parameter.
20	
21	    It supports bf16 mixed-precision training. Additionally, the optimizer
22	    implements overlapping operations for improved performance, including
23	    gradient transfer from device to host (D2H) and parameter transfer
24	    from host to device (H2D).
25	
26	    Example:
27	        from transformer_engine.pytorch.optimizers import FusedAdam as GPUAdam
28	        from torch.optim import AdamW as CPUAdam
29	        optimizer = HybridDeviceOptimizer(
30	            param_groups,
31	            cpu_optimizer_cls=CPUAdam,
32	            gpu_optimizer_cls=GPUAdam,
33	            offload_fraction=0.5,
34	            param_update_in_fp32=True,
35	            overlap_cpu_optimizer_d2h_h2d=True,
36	        )
37	        optimizer.step()
38	
39	    Note:
40	        This optimizer is particularly useful in scenarios where memory
41	        constraints are present or when leveraging both CPU and GPU resources
42	        can lead to performance improvements.
43	    """
44	
45	    def __init__(
46	        self,
47	        params,
48	        offload_fraction=0.5,

50	        gpu_optimizer_cls=None,

57	        super(HybridDeviceOptimizer, self).__init__(
58	            params,
59	            defaults={

61	                "cpu_optimizer_cls": cpu_optimizer_cls,
62	                "gpu_optimizer_cls": gpu_optimizer_cls,
63	                "param_update_in_fp32": param_update_in_fp32,
64	                "pin_cpu_grads": pin_cpu_grads,
65	                "pin_cpu_params": pin_cpu_params,
66	                "overlap_cpu_optimizer_d2h_h2d": overlap_cpu_optimizer_d2h_h2d,
67	                **kwargs,
68	            },

72	        self.cpu_optimizer_cls = cpu_optimizer_cls
73	        self.gpu_optimizer_cls = gpu_optimizer_cls
74	        self.pin_cpu_grads = pin_cpu_grads

83	    def _set_sub_optimizer_grads(self):
84	        if self.param_update_in_fp32:
85	            for param in self.param_to_fp32_param:
86	                if param in self.gpu_params_map_cpu_copy:
87	                    # Skip if the param is offloaded to CPU, it should be handled
88	                    # in the following part.
89	                    continue
90	                fp32_param = self.param_to_fp32_param[param]
91	                grad = getattr(param, "decoupled_grad", param.grad)

99	        for optimizer in self.cpu_optimizers:

117	    def _register_param_copy_back_gpu_hook(self):
118	        def param_copy_back_gpu_hook_closure():
119	            def param_copy_back_gpu_hook(optimizer, args, kwargs):
120	                self._h2d_stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())

150	    def step(self, closure=None):
151	        """
152	        Override the step method to perform the following operations:
153	            1. Sync the HDO param_groups to sub-optimizers.
154	            2. Sync the grads from GPU to CPU.
155	            3. Step the sub-optimizers.

160	        self._sync_hdo_param_groups_to_sub_optimizers()
161

173	                d2h_event.synchronize()

175	
176	        # Sync state and param_groups to HDO after each step.
177	        # NOTE: It is possible for the optimizer to change the properties
178	        #   in param_groups.
179	        self._sync_sub_optimizers_state_to_hdo()

228	        """Build several cpu optimizers to enable overlap. Currently we naively
229	        assign each parameter to an individual optimizer.

233	            cpu_param_groups (List[Dict[str, Any]]): The CPU parameter groups
234	        """
235	        cpu_optimizers = []
236	
237	        if len(cpu_param_groups) == 0:
238	            return cpu_optimizers
239	
240	        for group in cpu_param_groups:
241	            group_defaults = group.copy()
242	            params = group_defaults.pop("params")
243	            if isinstance(params, torch.Tensor):
244	                params = [params]
245	            for param in params:
246	                _cpu_param_group = group_defaults.copy()
247	                _cpu_param_group["params"] = [param]
248	                cpu_optimizers.append(cpu_optimizer_cls([_cpu_param_group]))

251	    def _get_sub_optimizer_param_groups(self, offload_fraction: float):
252	        params = []
253	        for group in self.param_groups:
254	            params.extend(group["params"])
255	        params_total_numel = sum([param.numel() for param in params])
256	        gpu_params_total_numel = sum([param.numel() for param in params if param.is_cuda])
257	        cpu_params_total_numel = params_total_numel - gpu_params_total_numel
258	        offload_threshold = gpu_params_total_numel * offload_fraction
259	        offload_params_numel = 0
260	        cpu_param_groups = []
261	        gpu_param_groups = []
262	        gpu_params_map_cpu_copy = {}
263	        cpu_copys_map_gpu_param = {}
264	        param_to_fp32_param = {}
265	        for group in self.param_groups:
266	            gpu_group = group.copy()
267	            cpu_group = group.copy()
268	            gpu_group["params"] = []
269	            cpu_group["params"] = []
270	            for param in group["params"]:
271	                orig_param = param

227	    def build_cpu_optimizer_list(cpu_optimizer_cls, cpu_param_groups):
228	        """Build several cpu optimizers to enable overlap. Currently we naively
229	        assign each parameter to an individual optimizer.

251	    def _get_sub_optimizer_param_groups(self, offload_fraction: float):
252	        params = []
253	        for group in self.param_groups:
254	            params.extend(group["params"])
255	        params_total_numel = sum([param.numel() for param in params])
256	        gpu_params_total_numel = sum([param.numel() for param in params if param.is_cuda])
257	        cpu_params_total_numel = params_total_numel - gpu_params_total_numel
258	        offload_threshold = gpu_params_total_numel * offload_fraction
259	        offload_params_numel = 0
260	        cpu_param_groups = []
261	        gpu_param_groups = []
262	        gpu_params_map_cpu_copy = {}
263	        cpu_copys_map_gpu_param = {}
264	        param_to_fp32_param = {}
265	        for group in self.param_groups:
266	            gpu_group = group.copy()
267	            cpu_group = group.copy()
268	            gpu_group["params"] = []
269	            cpu_group["params"] = []
270	            for param in group["params"]:
271	                orig_param = param
272	                cpu_copy = False
273	                if offload_params_numel < offload_threshold and param.is_cuda:
274	                    param = param.detach().clone().cpu().pin_memory()
275	                    offload_params_numel += param.numel()
276	                    cpu_copy = True
277	                if self.param_update_in_fp32 and param.dtype != torch.float32:
278	                    param = param.detach().clone().float()
279	                    param_to_fp32_param[orig_param] = param
280	
281	                if cpu_copy:
282	                    gpu_params_map_cpu_copy[orig_param] = param
283	                    cpu_copys_map_gpu_param[param] = orig_param
284	
285	                if param.is_cuda:
286	                    gpu_group["params"].append(param)
287	                else:
288	                    cpu_group["params"].append(param)
289	            if len(gpu_group["params"]) != 0:
290	                gpu_param_groups.append(gpu_group)
291	            if len(cpu_group["params"]) != 0:
292	                cpu_param_groups.append(cpu_group)
293	
294	        return (
295	            cpu_param_groups,
296	            gpu_param_groups,
297	            gpu_params_map_cpu_copy,
298	            cpu_copys_map_gpu_param,
299	            param_to_fp32_param,
300	        )

307	    def _build_model_and_main_param_groups(
308	        cls,
309	        gbuf_ranges: List[Dict],
310	        param_gbuf_map: Dict[torch.nn.Parameter, Tuple],
311	        opt_group_ranges: List,
312	        config: OptimizerConfig,
313	    ):
314	        """
315	        Create main parameter groups needed for the optimizer step.
316	
317	        These groups encompass both: 1) groups used by this class, for
318	        reducing/gather, and 2) groups used by the inner optimizer for the
319	        parameter update. Given that the conceptual grad buffer partitioning
320	        (created in earlier method) doesn't respect parameter boundaries,
321	        the optimizer operates on shards of the model parameters, rather than
322	        the full parameters.
323	        """
324	
325	        # Parameter groups:
326	        #   model_float16_groups: original float16 parameters
327	        #   model_fp32_groups: original fp32 parameters
328	        #   shard_float16_groups: shards of original float16 parameters
329	        #   shard_fp32_groups: shards of original fp32 parameters
330	        #   shard_fp32_from_float16_groups: fp32 copy of float16 parameters
331	        model_float16_groups = []
332	        model_fp32_groups = []
333	        shard_float16_groups = []
334	        shard_fp32_groups = []
335	        shard_fp32_from_float16_groups = []
336	
337	        # Allocate (or slice) each group's param shard.
338	        for group_range in opt_group_ranges:
339	
340	            # Params of this group.
341	            model_float16_params_this_group = []
342	            model_fp32_params_this_group = []
343	            shard_float16_params_this_group = []
344	            shard_fp32_params_this_group = []
345	            shard_fp32_from_float16_params_this_group = []
346	            model_float16_groups.append(model_float16_params_this_group)
347	            model_fp32_groups.append(model_fp32_params_this_group)
348	            shard_float16_groups.append(shard_float16_params_this_group)
349	            shard_fp32_groups.append(shard_fp32_params_this_group)
350	            shard_fp32_from_float16_groups.append(shard_fp32_from_float16_params_this_group)
351	
352	            for model_param in group_range["params"]:
353	
354	                assert model_param.requires_grad
355	
356	                gbuf_index, dtype, bucket_index = param_gbuf_map[model_param]
357	                gbuf_range = gbuf_ranges[gbuf_index][dtype][bucket_index]
358	                param_range = gbuf_range["param_map"][model_param]["param"]
359	
360	                # fp16, bf16 params.
361	                if model_param.type() in ['torch.cuda.HalfTensor', 'torch.cuda.BFloat16Tensor']:
362	
363	                    # Generate sharded model param.
364	                    if is_float8tensor(model_param) and config.fp8_recipe != "delayed":
365	                        # MXFP8Tensor and BlockwiseQTensor don't support view(-1)
366	                        shard_model_param = None
367	                    else:
368	                        shard_model_param = model_param.detach().view(-1)[
369	                            param_range.start : param_range.end
370	                        ]
371	                        tensor_parallel.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(
372	                            shard_model_param, model_param
373	                        )
374	                        if hasattr(model_param, 'shared'):
375	                            shard_model_param.shared = model_param.shared
376	
377	                    # Generate main param.
378	                    if not config.use_precision_aware_optimizer_no_fp8_or_ds_fp8:
379	                        # If we use FP8 params to initialize FP32 main params (compared to using the
380	                        # bf16/fp16 params to initialize the main params), there will be a loss of
381	                        # precision at the beginning of training (this problem will not occur if the
382	                        # training is long enough or if the main params are loaded from a
383	                        # checkpoint).
384	                        if is_float8tensor(model_param):
385	                            if hasattr(model_param, 'get_high_precision_init_val'):
386	                                shard_main_param = (
387	                                    model_param.get_high_precision_init_val()
388	                                    .view(-1)[param_range.start : param_range.end]
389	                                    .clone()
390	                                    .to(model_param.device)
391	                                    .float()
392	                                )
393	                                model_param.clear_high_precision_init_val()
394	                            else:
395	                                shard_main_param = model_param.float().view(-1)[
396	                                    param_range.start : param_range.end
397	                                ]
398	                        else:
399	                            shard_main_param = shard_model_param.clone().float()
400	
401	                        tensor_parallel.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(
402	                            shard_main_param, model_param
403	                        )
404	                        if hasattr(model_param, 'shared'):
405	                            shard_main_param.shared = model_param.shared
406	                    else:
407	                        # When using precision-aware optimizer, main params are held by FusedAdam.
408	                        shard_main_param = None
409	
410	                    # Store handle to main_param.
411	                    model_param.main_param = shard_main_param
412	                    model_param.main_param_sharded = True
413	
414	                    # Add to group.
415	                    model_float16_params_this_group.append(model_param)
416	                    shard_float16_params_this_group.append(shard_model_param)
417	                    shard_fp32_from_float16_params_this_group.append(shard_main_param)
418	
419	                # fp32 params.
420	                elif model_param.type() == 'torch.cuda.FloatTensor':
421	                    shard_model_param = model_param.view(-1)[param_range.start : param_range.end]
422	                    model_fp32_params_this_group.append(model_param)
423	                    shard_fp32_params_this_group.append(shard_model_param)

                gbuf_index, dtype, bucket_index = param_gbuf_map[model_param]
                gbuf_range = gbuf_ranges[gbuf_index][dtype][bucket_index]
                param_range = gbuf_range["param_map"][model_param]["param"]

                # fp16, bf16 params.
                if model_param.type() in ['torch.cuda.HalfTensor', 'torch.cuda.BFloat16Tensor']:

                    # Generate sharded model param.
                    if is_float8tensor(model_param) and config.fp8_recipe != "delayed":
                        # MXFP8Tensor and BlockwiseQTensor don't support view(-1)
                        shard_model_param = None
                    else:
                        shard_model_param = model_param.detach().view(-1)[
                            param_range.start : param_range.end
                        ]
                        tensor_parallel.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(
                            shard_model_param, model_param
                        )
                        if hasattr(model_param, 'shared'):
                            shard_model_param.shared = model_param.shared

                    # Generate main param.
                    if not config.use_precision_aware_optimizer_no_fp8_or_ds_fp8:
                        # If we use FP8 params to initialize FP32 main params (compared to using the
                        # bf16/fp16 params to initialize the main params), there will be a loss of
                        # precision at the beginning of training (this problem will not occur if the
                        # training is long enough or if the main params are loaded from a
                        # checkpoint).
                        if is_float8tensor(model_param):
                            if hasattr(model_param, 'get_high_precision_init_val'):
                                shard_main_param = (
                                    model_param.get_high_precision_init_val()
                                    .view(-1)[param_range.start : param_range.end]
                                    .clone()
                                    .to(model_param.device)
                                    .float()
                                )
                                model_param.clear_high_precision_init_val()
                            else:
                                shard_main_param = model_param.float().view(-1)[
                                    param_range.start : param_range.end
                                ]
                        else:
                            shard_main_param = shard_model_param.clone().float()

                        tensor_parallel.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(
                            shard_main_param, model_param
                        )
                        if hasattr(model_param, 'shared'):
                            shard_main_param.shared = model_param.shared
                    else:
                        # When using precision-aware optimizer, main params are held by FusedAdam.
                        shard_main_param = None

                    # Store handle to main_param.
                    model_param.main_param = shard_main_param
                    model_param.main_param_sharded = True

                    # Add to group.
                    model_float16_params_this_group.append(model_param)
                    shard_float16_params_this_group.append(shard_model_param)
                    shard_fp32_from_float16_params_this_group.append(shard_main_param)

                # fp32 params.
                elif model_param.type() == 'torch.cuda.FloatTensor':
                    shard_model_param = model_param.view(-1)[param_range.start : param_range.end]
                    model_fp32_params_this_group.append(model_param)
                    shard_fp32_params_this_group.append(shard_model_param)
                    tensor_parallel.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(
                        shard_model_param, model_param
                    )
                    if hasattr(model_param, 'shared'):
                        shard_model_param.shared = model_param.shared

                else:
                    raise TypeError(
                        'Wrapped parameters must be one of '
                        'torch.cuda.FloatTensor,  '
                        'torch.cuda.HalfTensor, or '
                        'torch.cuda.BFloat16Tensor. '
                        'Received {}'.format(model_param.type())
                    )

            # Update optimizer's params.
            if not config.use_precision_aware_optimizer_no_fp8_or_ds_fp8:
                group_range["orig_group"]["params"] = [
                    *shard_fp32_params_this_group,
                    *shard_fp32_from_float16_params_this_group,
                ]
            else:
                group_range["orig_group"]["params"] = [
                    *shard_fp32_params_this_group,
                    *shard_float16_params_this_group,
                ]

        return (
            model_float16_groups,
            model_fp32_groups,
            shard_float16_groups,
            shard_fp32_groups,
            shard_fp32_from_float16_groups,
        )

    def __init__(

        optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
        config: OptimizerConfig,
        grad_scaler: MegatronGradScaler,
        init_state_fn: Optional[Callable],
        model_chunks: List[MegatronModule],
        per_model_buffers: Dict[int, List[_ParamAndGradBuffer]],
        data_parallel_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
        data_parallel_group_gloo: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup],
        data_parallel_group_idx: int,

        The steps in this method create the core mapping between param and grad buffers,
        parameters, and parameter shard ranges, that is needed for converting between model
        param indexes and main parameter shard indexes. This method also updates the optimizer
        parameter groups with the newly created shards.

        Args:
            optimizer (torch.optim.Optimizer): base optimizer such as Adam or SGD.
            config (OptimizerConfig): configuration object for optimizer.
            grad_scaler (MegatronGradScaler): used for scaling gradients. Note that
                this can be None. This case happens when `bf16 = True` and we don't
                use any loss scale. Note that for `bf16 = True`, we can have
                a constant gradient scaler. Also for `bf16 = False`, we
                always require a grad scaler.
            init_state_fn (Callable, optional): function to initialize state in the optimizer.
            model_chunks (List[MegatronModule]): list of model chunks.
            per_model_buffers (Dict[int, List[_ParamAndGradBuffer]]): the implementation of the
                distributed optimizer is centered on using a contiguous buffer for
                communicating grads & params between the model state and the optimizer state.
                You can find a more detailed description in
                https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/source/distrib_optimizer.md.

                all-gather params after optimizer.step().

                distributed checkpointing logic).
            distributed_optimizer_instance_id (int): index of the Distributed Optimizer instance.
        """

            log_config_to_disk(config, locals(), prefix=type(self).__name__)

        super().__init__(optimizer, config, grad_scaler, init_state_fn)
        self.model_chunks = model_chunks
        self.ddp_config = self.model_chunks[0].ddp_config
        for model_chunk in self.model_chunks:
            assert self.ddp_config == model_chunk.ddp_config
        self.distributed_optimizer_instance_id = distributed_optimizer_instance_id

        assert (
            isinstance(optimizer, (Adam, torch.optim.AdamW, HybridDeviceOptimizer))
            or optimizer is None
        ), (
            "Only Adam and HybridDeviceOptimizer currently supported, "
            "due to checkpointing requirements."

        # but still need a stub DistributedOptimizer class

            self.is_stub_optimizer = True

        if self.ddp_config.use_megatron_fsdp:
            return

        # Model grad buffer ranges.
        assert per_model_buffers is not None, "per_model_buffers must be provided"
        self.buffers = list(itertools.chain(*per_model_buffers.values()))
        self.per_model_buffers = per_model_buffers
        self.data_parallel_group = data_parallel_group
        self.data_parallel_group_gloo = data_parallel_group_gloo
        self.data_parallel_group_idx = data_parallel_group_idx

        self.gbuf_idx_to_model_idx_map = {}
        gbuf_idx = 0
        for model_idx, buffers in self.per_model_buffers.items():
            for _ in buffers:
                self.gbuf_idx_to_model_idx_map[gbuf_idx] = model_idx
                gbuf_idx += 1

        self.per_model_bucket_groups = {}
        for model_idx, buffers in self.per_model_buffers.items():
            self.per_model_bucket_groups[model_idx] = partition_buckets(buffers)

        self.gbuf_ranges = []
        self.per_bucket_numel = []
        self.per_bucket_numel_unpadded = []
        for buffer in self.buffers:

            self.per_bucket_numel.append(
                {
                    (buffer.param_dtype, buffer.grad_dtype): [
                        bucket.grad_data.numel() for bucket in buffer.buckets
                    ]
                }
            )
            self.per_bucket_numel_unpadded.append(
                {
                    (buffer.param_dtype, buffer.grad_dtype): [
                        bucket.numel_unpadded for bucket in buffer.buckets

                }

            self.gbuf_ranges.append(self._build_gbuf_range_map(buffer))
        self.model_param_gbuf_map = self._build_model_param_gbuf_map(self.gbuf_ranges)

        # the param norm.
        # For parameters with optimizer state on this rank, None will be overwritten by
        # the corresponding sharded main_param tensor.
        for param_group in self.optimizer.param_groups:

            self._build_optimizer_group_ranges(self.optimizer.param_groups, self.gbuf_ranges)

            self.model_float16_groups,
            self.model_fp32_groups,
            self.shard_float16_groups,
            self.shard_fp32_groups,
            self.shard_fp32_from_float16_groups,

    def _get_model_param_range_map(self, param: torch.nn.Parameter):
        """
        Given a model param, get the index sub-range of the param that this
        data-parallel rank owns.
        """
        gbuf_index, dtype, bucket_index = self.model_param_gbuf_map[param]
        gbuf_range_map = self.gbuf_ranges[gbuf_index][dtype][bucket_index]
        param_range_map = gbuf_range_map["param_map"][param]
        return param_range_map

        with the non-distributed optimizer).

        return getattr(self, 'grad_stats_parallel_group', None)

        param_to_sharded_metadata = {}
        model_sharded_state_dict, _ = extract_sharded_tensors_and_factories(
            model_sharded_state_dict
        )
        for sh_base in nested_values(model_sharded_state_dict):
            param_to_sharded_metadata[sh_base.data] = sh_base

        prefix = 'optimizer.state'
        state = {}

        # Not stored in the checkpoint, used only to identify params in
        # `sharded_param_state_fs_model_space`.
        def _get_param_state_sharded_tensors(model_param, item_slice):
            # Main param & optimizer states.
            tensors = self._get_main_param_and_optimizer_states(model_param)
            tensors["fp32_param"] = tensors.pop("param")

            # Match optimizer parameter with model ShardedTensor (or
            # ShardedTensorFactory).
            try:
                sharded_metadata = param_to_sharded_metadata[model_param]
            except KeyError as e:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Model param {model_param} not in model_sharded_state_dict"
                    f" Hint: {KEEP_VARS_HINT}"
                ) from e

            # Set DP corresponding replica_id coordinate to 0.
            assert (
                len(sharded_metadata.replica_id) == 3
            ), f'Expected replica_id format (PP, TP, DP), got: {sharded_metadata}'
            replica_id = (*sharded_metadata.replica_id[:2], self.distributed_optimizer_instance_id)

            # Instantiate ShardedTensor (or ShardedTensorFactory) for optimizer
            # params.
            for state_key, state_ten in tensors.items():
                if state_key == 'step':
                    # Note that step is a 0-dim tensor, unlike other
                    # states have the same size as the parameter.
                    # The optimizer state of STEP is handled
                    # specifically and is read from param_groups.
                    continue
                replace_kwargs = dict(
                    key=f'{prefix}.{state_key}.{sharded_metadata.key}',
                    data=state_ten,
                    dtype=state_ten.dtype,
                    flattened_range=item_slice,
                    replica_id=replica_id,
                )
                if isinstance(sharded_metadata, ShardedTensorFactory):
                    replace_kwargs.pop('dtype')
                tensors[state_key] = replace(sharded_metadata, **replace_kwargs)
                tensors[state_key].validate_metadata_integrity()
            return tensors

        # Not stored in the checkpoint, used only to identify params in
        # `sharded_param_state_fs_model_space`.
        param_idx = 0
        for gbuf_range_maps in self.gbuf_ranges:
            for gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets in gbuf_range_maps.values():
                for gbuf_range_map in gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets:
                    for model_param, param_range_map in gbuf_range_map["param_map"].items():
                        param_range = param_range_map['param']
                        tensors = _get_param_state_sharded_tensors(
                            model_param, slice(param_range.start, param_range.end)
                        )
                        state[param_idx] = tensors
                        param_idx += 1
        return state

    def load_parameter_state_from_dp_reshardable(self, state_dict):
        """Loads the parameter state from an internal representation.

        Inverse of the `get_parameter_state_dp_reshardable` method.
        """
        if state_dict is not None and "per_bucket_numel_unpadded" in state_dict:
            per_bucket_numel_unpadded_in_checkpoint = state_dict["per_bucket_numel_unpadded"]
            assert self.per_bucket_numel_unpadded == per_bucket_numel_unpadded_in_checkpoint, (
                f"Number of unpadded elements in each bucket need to be the same in current run "
                f"({self.per_bucket_numel_unpadded}) and checkpoint "
                f"({per_bucket_numel_unpadded_in_checkpoint})"
            )

        for gbuf_idx, gbuf_range_maps in enumerate(self.gbuf_ranges):
            assert len(gbuf_range_maps) == 1, "single dtype supported, for now."
            for dtype, gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets in gbuf_range_maps.items():
                for bucket_idx, gbuf_range_map in enumerate(gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets):
                    bucket_state = state_dict[gbuf_idx][dtype][bucket_idx]
                    bucket_state = [
                        bucket_state_elem
                        for bucket_state_elem in bucket_state
                        if not bucket_state_elem['padding']
                    ]

                    assert len(bucket_state) == len(gbuf_range_map["param_map"]), (
                        len(bucket_state),
                        len(gbuf_range_map["param_map"]),
                    )
                    for src_tensors, (model_param, param_range_map) in zip(
                        bucket_state, gbuf_range_map["param_map"].items()
                    ):
                        # Main param & optimizer states.
                        self._set_main_param_and_optimizer_states(model_param, src_tensors)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def load_parameter_state_from_fs_model_space(self, state_dict):
        """Loads the parameter state from a "model space" representation.

        Inverse of the `sharded_param_state_fs_model_space` method.
        """
        param_idx = 0  # matching order with `sharded_param_state_fs_model_space`
        for gbuf_range_maps in self.gbuf_ranges:
            for gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets in gbuf_range_maps.values():
                for gbuf_range_map in gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets:
                    for model_param, param_range_map in gbuf_range_map["param_map"].items():
                        src_tensors = {}
                        for k, v in state_dict[param_idx].items():
                            if k == "step":
                                # Handle torch Adam "step" state separately.
                                continue
                            if k == "fp32_param":
                                src_tensors["param"] = v
                            else:
                                src_tensors[k] = v
                        self._set_main_param_and_optimizer_states(model_param, src_tensors)
                        param_idx += 1
        if isinstance(self.optimizer, HybridDeviceOptimizer):
            self.optimizer._sync_hdo_state_to_sub_optimizers()

    @classmethod
    def _update_legacy_world_tensors(cls, old_tensors, new_numels):
        '''Reshard buckets (where each bucket is a tensor) to new target
        numels, where the total numel remains the same.'''

        old_total = sum([t.numel() for t in old_tensors])
        new_total = sum(new_numels)

        assert old_total == new_total

        unified_tensor = torch.cat(old_tensors, dim=0)

        new_tensors = []
        start_idx = 0
        for new_numel in new_numels:
            new_tensors.append(unified_tensor[start_idx : (start_idx + new_numel)])
            start_idx += new_numel

        return new_tensors

    def load_parameter_state_from_dp_zero_legacy(self, state_dict):
        """Load parameter state (i.e., parameter & optimizer tensors) from DP 0 rank,
        using the legacy checkpoint format as described below.

        The difference between this method and `load_parameter_state_from_dp_zero_modern()`
        is that this method is used for updating the format of checkpoints that
        were saved using code from before Feb 13, 2024. Starting on this date, a
        new format was used (i.e., different format for the parameter mapping and
        bucket sharding).

        Use arg `--ckpt-convert-update-legacy-dist-opt-format` to call this
        method, along with `--ckpt-convert-format` and `--ckpt-convert-save` to
        update a legacy-format checkpoint to the modern format.
        """

        # Data parallelism variables.
        assert self.data_parallel_group_gloo is not None
        data_parallel_world_size = self.data_parallel_group_gloo.size()
        data_parallel_rank = self.data_parallel_group_gloo.rank()
        data_parallel_group_gloo = self.data_parallel_group_gloo
        data_parallel_global_ranks = torch.distributed.get_process_group_ranks(
            self.data_parallel_group_gloo
        )

        # Scatter tensors to all DP ranks.
        for gbuf_idx, gbuf_range_maps in enumerate(self.gbuf_ranges):
            for dtype, gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets in gbuf_range_maps.items():
                if data_parallel_rank == 0:
                    buffer_numel_unpadded = self.buffers[gbuf_idx].numel_unpadded
                    model_numels = [b.numel_unpadded for b in self.buffers[gbuf_idx].buckets]
                    checkpoint_numels = [
                        t.numel() for t in state_dict[gbuf_idx][torch.float32]["param"]
                    ]
                    assert sum(model_numels) == sum(checkpoint_numels)
                for key in ("param", "exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq"):
                    legacy_world_tensors = self._update_legacy_world_tensors(
                        state_dict[gbuf_idx][torch.float32][key],
                        [
                            self.buffers[gbuf_idx].buckets[bi].numel_unpadded
                            for bi in range(len(gbuf_range_map_for_all_buckets))

                    )
                    offset_in_world_tensors = 0

                        # Compute local DP contiguous shard's size.
                        gbuf_world_numel = (
                            self.buffers[gbuf_idx].buckets[bucket_idx].grad_data.numel()
                        )
                        assert gbuf_world_numel % data_parallel_world_size == 0

                        gbuf_world_numel_unpadded = (
                            self.buffers[gbuf_idx].buckets[bucket_idx].numel_unpadded
                        )
                        assert gbuf_world_numel_unpadded <= gbuf_world_numel

                        # Contiguous local shards (received from DP rank 0).
                        recv_tensor = torch.zeros(
                            (gbuf_local_numel,), dtype=torch.float32, device="cpu"
                        )

                        # Scatter tensor list.
                        if data_parallel_rank == 0:

                            start = offset_in_world_tensors
                            end = offset_in_world_tensors + gbuf_world_numel_unpadded

                            world_tensor = legacy_world_tensors[bucket_idx]
                            assert (
                                world_tensor.numel() == gbuf_world_numel_unpadded
                            ), "%d vs. %d." % (world_tensor.numel(), gbuf_world_numel_unpadded)
                            offset_in_world_tensors += gbuf_world_numel_unpadded

                            # Pad world_tensor to gbuf_world_numel. Don't pad at the front,
                            # pad at the back.
                            world_tensor = torch.nn.functional.pad(
                                world_tensor, (0, gbuf_world_numel - gbuf_world_numel_unpadded)
                            )
                            assert world_tensor.numel() == gbuf_world_numel
                            gbuf_start_idxs = list(range(0, gbuf_world_numel, gbuf_local_numel))
                            send_tensors = [
                                world_tensor[i : (i + gbuf_local_numel)] for i in gbuf_start_idxs
                            ]

                            send_tensors = None

                            recv_tensor,
                            send_tensors,
                            data_parallel_global_ranks[0],
                            data_parallel_group_gloo,
                        )

                        for model_param, param_range_map in gbuf_range_map["param_map"].items():

                            group_index, group_order = self.model_param_group_index_map[model_param]
                            main_param = self.optimizer.param_groups[group_index]["params"][
                                group_order
                            ]

                                tensor_to_copy_into = main_param
                            else:
                                optim_state = self.optimizer.state[main_param]
                                tensor_to_copy_into = optim_state[key]

                            # Copy states into contiguous shard.

                            tensor_to_copy_into.data.copy_(
                                recv_tensor[gbuf_local_start:gbuf_local_end]

2127	        dtype) are stored in separate `_ParamAndGradBuffer`. Therefore, when we enabled
2128	        "--fp8-param-gather", and want to load a checkpoint saved without "--fp8-param-gather", we

2136	                if is_float8tensor(self.buffers[gbuf_idx].params[0]):
2137	                    fp8_gbuf_indices.append(gbuf_idx)

2120	    def split_state_dict_if_needed(self, state_dict):
2121	        """
2122	        When "--fp8-param-gather" is disabled, weights and biases are stored in the same
2123	        `_ParamAndGradBuffer`. So, when saving a checkpoint, the optimizer's main parameters are
2124	        saved in a single continuous tensor (this also applies to "exp_avg" and "exp_avg_sq").
2125	
2126	        However, when "--fp8-param-gather" is enabled, weights(in fp8 dtype) and biases(in bf16/fp16
2127	        dtype) are stored in separate `_ParamAndGradBuffer`. Therefore, when we enabled
2128	        "--fp8-param-gather", and want to load a checkpoint saved without "--fp8-param-gather", we
2129	        need to split the weights(fp8) and biases(bf16/fp16) in the static_dict into two separate
2130	        tensors.
2131	        """
2132	        # Skip if there is no fp8 buffers.
2133	        fp8_gbuf_indices = []
2134	        for gbuf_idx, gbuf_range_maps in enumerate(self.gbuf_ranges):
2135	            for dtype, _ in gbuf_range_maps.items():
2136	                if is_float8tensor(self.buffers[gbuf_idx].params[0]):
2137	                    fp8_gbuf_indices.append(gbuf_idx)
2138	        if len(fp8_gbuf_indices) == 0:
2139	            return
2140	
2141	        dtype_to_gbuf_idx = {}
2142	        for key in state_dict.keys():
2143	            if key != 'buckets_coalesced':
2144	                for dtype in state_dict[key].keys():
2145	                    assert dtype not in dtype_to_gbuf_idx
2146	                    if dtype[0] == torch.uint8:
2147	                        # If the `state_dict`` already contains a torch.uint8 buffer, we assumed
2148	                        # that the fp8 weights and fp16/bf16 biases in the checkpoint are already
2149	                        # separated. In this case, no action is required, so we can return directly.
2150	                        return
2151	                    dtype_to_gbuf_idx[dtype] = key
2152	
2153	        # 1. Replace the gbuf_idx in the checkpoint with the new gbuf_idx.
2154	        # 2. Copy the non-tensor data (i.e., the "buckets_coalesced") to `new_state_dict`.
2155	        new_state_dict = {'buckets_coalesced': state_dict['buckets_coalesced']}
2156	        for gbuf_idx, gbuf_range_maps in enumerate(self.gbuf_ranges):
2157	            for dtype, _ in gbuf_range_maps.items():
2158	                if not is_float8tensor(self.buffers[gbuf_idx].params[0]):
2159	                    new_state_dict[gbuf_idx] = state_dict[dtype_to_gbuf_idx[dtype]]
2160	
2161	        for fp8_gbuf_idx in fp8_gbuf_indices:
2162	            # Note that `self.buffers[fp8_gbuf_idx].params[0].dtype` is the dummy dtype of
2163	            # `Float8Tensor`, not torch.uint8.
2164	            non_fp8_param_and_grad_dtype = (
2165	                self.buffers[fp8_gbuf_idx].params[0].dtype,
2166	                self.buffers[fp8_gbuf_idx].grad_dtype,
2167	            )
2168	
2169	            # Iterate through all buffers to find the one that needs to be split.
2170	            non_fp8_gbuf_idx = None
2171	            for gbuf_idx, gbuf_range_maps in enumerate(self.gbuf_ranges):
2172	                for dtype, _ in gbuf_range_maps.items():
2173	                    if dtype == non_fp8_param_and_grad_dtype:
2174	                        non_fp8_gbuf_idx = gbuf_idx
2175	            assert non_fp8_gbuf_idx is not None
2176	
2177	            # We need the fp8_flags to determine the order of weight (fp8) and bias (fp16/bf16) in
2178	            # the buffer.
2179	            index_to_fp8_map = {}
2180	            for index in self.buffers[fp8_gbuf_idx].param_indices:
2181	                assert index not in index_to_fp8_map
2182	                index_to_fp8_map[index] = True
2183	            for index in self.buffers[non_fp8_gbuf_idx].param_indices:
2184	                assert index not in index_to_fp8_map
2185	                index_to_fp8_map[index] = False
2186	            param_indices = (
2187	                self.buffers[fp8_gbuf_idx].param_indices
2188	                + self.buffers[non_fp8_gbuf_idx].param_indices
2189	            )
2190	            assert min(param_indices) == 0
2191	            assert max(param_indices) == len(param_indices) - 1
2192	            fp8_flags = []
2193	            for i in range(len(param_indices)):
2194	                fp8_flags.append(index_to_fp8_map[i])
2195	
2196	            fp8_buffer = self.buffers[fp8_gbuf_idx]
2197	            non_fp8_buffer = self.buffers[non_fp8_gbuf_idx]
2198	
2199	            fp8_idx = len(fp8_buffer.params) - 1
2200	            non_fp8_idx = len(non_fp8_buffer.params) - 1
2201	            offsets, fp8_offsets, non_fp8_offsets = [0], [0], [0]
2202	
2203	            # Because the parameters in `_ParamAndGradBuffer` are traversed in reverse order, the
2204	            # flag here also needs to be traversed in reverse order.
2205	            for fp8_flag in fp8_flags[::-1]:
2206	                if fp8_flag:
2207	                    numel = fp8_buffer.params[fp8_idx].nelement()
2208	                    fp8_idx -= 1
2209	                    offsets.append(offsets[-1] + numel)
2210	                    fp8_offsets.append(fp8_offsets[-1] + numel)
2211	                else:
2212	                    numel = non_fp8_buffer.params[non_fp8_idx].nelement()
2213	                    non_fp8_idx -= 1
2214	                    offsets.append(offsets[-1] + numel)
2215	                    non_fp8_offsets.append(non_fp8_offsets[-1] + numel)
2216	
2217	            # Split the target buffer into two separate buffers.
2218	            fp8_state_dict, non_fp8_state_dict = {}, {}
2219	            for key in ['param', 'exp_avg', 'exp_avg_sq']:
2220	                tensor = state_dict[non_fp8_gbuf_idx][non_fp8_param_and_grad_dtype][key]
2221	                fp8_tensor = torch.empty([fp8_offsets[-1]], dtype=tensor.dtype)
2222	                non_fp8_tensor = torch.empty([non_fp8_offsets[-1]], dtype=tensor.dtype)
2223	
2224	                fp8_idx, non_fp8_idx = 0, 0
2225	                for i in range(len(offsets) - 1):
2226	                    if fp8_flags[-(i + 1)]:
2227	                        fp8_tensor[fp8_offsets[fp8_idx] : fp8_offsets[fp8_idx + 1]].copy_(
2228	                            tensor[offsets[i] : offsets[i + 1]]
2229	                        )
2230	                        fp8_idx += 1
2231	                    else:
2232	                        non_fp8_tensor[
2233	                            non_fp8_offsets[non_fp8_idx] : non_fp8_offsets[non_fp8_idx + 1]
2234	                        ].copy_(tensor[offsets[i] : offsets[i + 1]])
2235	                        non_fp8_idx += 1
2236	
2237	                fp8_state_dict[key] = fp8_tensor
2238	                non_fp8_state_dict[key] = non_fp8_tensor
2239	
2240	            fp8_state_dict['numel_unpadded'] = fp8_offsets[-1]
2241	            non_fp8_state_dict['numel_unpadded'] = non_fp8_offsets[-1]
2242	
2243	            # Add the two separate buffers into `new_state_dict`.
2244	            new_state_dict[fp8_gbuf_idx] = {}
2245	            new_state_dict[fp8_gbuf_idx][(torch.uint8, fp8_buffer.grad_dtype)] = fp8_state_dict
2246	            new_state_dict[non_fp8_gbuf_idx][non_fp8_param_and_grad_dtype] = non_fp8_state_dict
2247	
2248	        # Inplace update state_dict
2249	        state_dict.clear()
2250	        for key, value in new_state_dict.items():
2251	            state_dict[key] = value

125	        contiguous regions, where each DP rank 'owns' a contiguous region.
126	        Ownership in this sense means DP rank is responsible for reducing
127	        the relevant subset of grads, and updating the relevant subset of
128	        params.

131	        parameter boundaries, and as such it is assumed that each created
132	        range references a shard (or subset) of the full parameter. It is
133	        easiest to think of each DP rank as operating (i.e., reducing,
134	        gathering) purely on views into the grad buffer, for all model-to-

154	            if param_local_end > param_local_start:

168	                    "param": sub_param_range,

194	
195	        # All world ranges (i.e., across all data parallel ranks).
196	        gbuf_world_all_ranges = []
197	        for r in range(data_parallel_world_size):
198	            # Compute start of chunk in this bucket.
199	            gbuf_world_start = r * max_gbuf_range_size
200	            gbuf_world_end = min(gbuf_size, gbuf_world_start + max_gbuf_range_size)

202	            gbuf_world_range = Range(

235	                cls._build_model_gbuf_range(param_and_grad_buffer, bucket_index)
236	                for bucket_index in range(len(param_and_grad_buffer.buckets))
237	            ]
238	        }

class Range:
    """
    A range represents a start and end points for indexing a shard
    from a full tensor.

    Args:
        start (int): Start index.
        end (int): End index.
    """

    def __init__(self, start: int, end: int):
        self.start = start
        self.end = end
        self.size = end - start

    def normalize(self, start: int = 0):
        """Shift start/end indexes to start at new start index.

        Both start and end indexes will be shifted by [new start] - [old start].

        Args:
            start (int): New start index.
        """
        return Range(start, start + self.size)

    def __str__(self):
        return "%d,%d [%d]" % (self.start, self.end, self.size)

    def __repr__(self):
        return str(self)

    def __len__(self):
        return self.end - self.start


class DistributedOptimizer(MixedPrecisionOptimizer):
    """Distributed optimizer, for all data types (fp16, bf16, and fp32).

    See __init__() below for argument details.
    """

    # enumerates fully reshardable optimizer formats (as opposed to formats
    # which depend on the internal optimizer buffers structure)
    checkpoint_fully_reshardable_formats: set[str] = {
        'fully_reshardable',
        'fully_sharded_model_space',
        'fsdp_dtensor',
    }

    @classmethod
    def _build_model_gbuf_param_range_map(
        cls,
        param_world_index_map: Dict[torch.nn.Parameter, Tuple],
        gbuf_world_range: Range,
        bucket_offset: int,
    ):
        """
        Build mapping from param reference to grad buffer shard ranges.

        This method builds a mapping from parameter references to grad
        buffer shard ranges, specific to each data-parallel (DP) rank's
        set of 'owned' parameters. Each grad buffer (padded to be an even
        multiple of DP-world-size) is conceptually divided into DP-world-size
        contiguous regions, where each DP rank 'owns' a contiguous region.
        Ownership in this sense means DP rank is responsible for reducing
        the relevant subset of grads, and updating the relevant subset of
        params.

        This conceptual partitioning of the grad buffer does NOT respect
        parameter boundaries, and as such it is assumed that each created
        range references a shard (or subset) of the full parameter. It is
        easiest to think of each DP rank as operating (i.e., reducing,
        gathering) purely on views into the grad buffer, for all model-to-
        main & main-to-model operations.

        This method creates four ranges:
        - The param's range within the entire grad buffer (i.e., world index).
        - The param's range within the relevant grad bucket's buffer.
        - The param's range within the DP rank's local view of the grad buffer.
        - The param's range within itself (i.e., its shard).
        """

        # Param range map.
        param_range_map = {}
        for param, param_world_indexes in param_world_index_map.items():
